Serrated_Predatory_Maw.description: A devastating jaw lined with recurved, highly serrated teeth. Functioning like biological steak knives, they are designed to shear massive chunks of flesh off struggling prey, inducing rapid catastrophic blood loss.

Hollow_Fanged_Venom_Jaw.description: A highly specialized, relatively fragile jaw equipped with front-mounted, hollow hypodermic fangs. The fangs are connected directly to massive venom glands, designed not to crush, but to deliver lethal neurotoxins.
